translations.literal: Management of Guards, Part 3 ○ Tribal Divisions, Part 2

sentences.zh: 遼起松漠，經營撫納，竟有唐、晉帝王之器，典章文物，施及潢海之區，作史者尚可以故俗語耶？

translations.literal: Liao rose from the Songmo desert, cultivated and embraced subjects, and in the end possessed the capacity of Tang and Jin emperors; its institutions and culture extended to the Huanghai region—can historians still use old tribal vernacular?
translations.idiomatic: Liao rose from the Songmo desert, cultivated and embraced its subjects, and in the end possessed the stature of Tang and Jin emperors; its institutions and culture reached the Huanghai region—can historians still write in the old tribal tongue?

sentences.zh: 舊史有《部族志》，歷代之所無也。

translations.literal: The old histories had Records of Tribal Divisions, something no previous dynasty possessed.
translations.idiomatic: The old histories contained Records of Tribal Divisions, something no previous dynasty had possessed.

sentences.zh: 古者，巡守於方嶽，五服之君各述其職，遼之部族實似之。

translations.literal: In antiquity the Son of Heaven toured the sacred peaks and the lords of the five domains each reported their duties; Liao's tribal divisions truly resembled this.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity the Son of Heaven made tours of the sacred peaks and the lords of the five domains each reported their duties; Liao's tribal divisions truly resembled this.

sentences.zh: 故以部族置宮衛、行營之後雲。

translations.literal: Therefore tribal divisions are placed after palace guards and traveling camps.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore tribal divisions are placed after palace guards and traveling camps.
